title: DNA extraction from fecal samples
author: Yoshiyuki Matsuo
materials: Briefly spin the tube to collect contents.

steps.title: Add fecal sample to tube
steps.instruction: Place 50–100 mg of fecal sample into a tube.

steps.title: Add PBS to sample
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of PBS for every 100 mg of feces.

steps.title: Vortex to mix
steps.instruction: Mix the sample thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate to sediment debris
steps.instruction: Allow the sample to stand for 00:02:00 (2 min) to sediment large debris.

steps.title: Transfer suspension aliquot
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the suspension to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 3 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet (≈30 mg of feces) in 300 µL of PBS.

steps.title: Heat incubation at 70 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 70 °C for 00:10:00 (10 min) on a block heater.

steps.title: Transfer to EZ‑Beads tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the suspension to an EZ‑Beads tube containing zirconium‑oxide beads (0.2 mm spheres and one 5 mm bead).

steps.title: Bead‑beating cell lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse cells by bead beating using one of the following methods:

substeps.instruction: a) Place the EZ‑Beads tube in a Micro Smash Beads Cell Disrupter (TOMY Digital Biology, MS‑100) and shake at 2500 rpm for 2 min (temperature not specified). Avoid devices with high‑speed linear reciprocating motion to prevent tube breakage.
b) Place the EZ‑Beads tube on an MN Bead Tube Holder (Rubber‑foam adapter, MACHEREY‑NAGEL, catalog 740469) attached to a Vortex‑Genie mixer and vortex for 00:05:00 (5 min) at maximum speed.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of Lysis Buffer and 30 µL of Proteinase K Solution to the sample in the EZ‑Beads tube.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 56 °C for 00:20:00 (20 min) on the block heater.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (~500 µL) to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 18 000 × g for 3 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Load lysate onto Maxwell cartridge
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared lysate to a Maxwell RSC Cartridge.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Elution Buffer to the elution tube.

steps.title: Run Maxwell extraction
steps.instruction: Start the extraction run on the Maxwell RSC instrument (Promega, AS4500) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Cool eluate to room temperature
steps.instruction: Cool the eluate to room temperature.
